purpose: Development-only overall dimension inputs read from the original fixture images for F alignment; not work-model output and not GT-derived.

coordinate_contract.x: World x increases east; the first west overall-dimension tick is x=0 m.
coordinate_contract.y: World y increases north; for a north-to-south tick order, the first north tick is y=the visible overall height and the last south tick is y=0 m.
coordinate_contract.pixel_axes: Original-image x increases right and y increases down.
